decision: CONSENT. Twenty-one dispatch attacks and eight independent attacks beyond the dispatch were run; all twenty-nine failed to land. Every one of the eleven cited digests was recomputed from disk and matches. The subject is unmoved at 61608c80… and mode 0444. HEAD, last live heading, and required-now 28 all reproduce. Both corpus v4 Stage A verdicts are ACCEPT 0/0, mutually unread, and mode 0444. The no-cell-edit range 'D-170 through D-235 and D-237 and D-238' correctly excludes D-236 and its two new segments are measured against their commits. The Stage A observations honesty block is exact on count, on the absence of identifiers, and on Codex's nullity. Zero blockers, zero MUST-FIX, zero SHOULD-FIX. Four observations are recorded and none requests a change.
